realized_ytd.source: Schwab official Realized Gain/Loss report (Accounts > History > Realized G/L, Current year, include option contracts)

realized_mtd.source: Schwab official Realized G/L CSV, rows with Closed Date in the month. Preferred over the transactions-API reconstruction, which understates.

_note: Beginning-period NLVs and the official realized YTD gain are provided by the account owner from Schwab statements/reports (the Trader API has no historical-balance or realized-G/L endpoint). Reconstructing realized P&L from the transactions API is unreliable because history only reaches back to 2025-12-05, truncating older lots. Update beginning_of_month and realized figures at the start of each new month / when the Schwab report changes.
